paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimation with different perturbation strength _q. Right: Influence of perturbation strength on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between perturbation strength and values associated with AU, TU, and EU. The x-axis is labeled "Perturbation Strength σq" and is linear, ranging from 0.02 to 0.5 with tick labels at 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, and 0.5. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 0.00 to 0.20 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. A red line, marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents AU and starts at approximately 0.13 when the perturbation strength is 0.02, decreases slightly to around 0.12 at 0.05, then increases to approximately 0.16 by a perturbation strength of 0.5. A blue line, marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents TU, beginning at approximately 0.12 at a perturbation strength of 0.02 and rising steadily to approximately 0.19 at a perturbation strength of 0.5. A green line, marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents EU, starting at approximately 0.01 at a perturbation strength of 0.02 and increasing to approximately 0.05 at a perturbation strength of 0.5.
